{{dablink|For other uses of the words "gate" and "heaven," see [[Gate]] and [[Heaven]].}}
'''The Gates of Heaven''' is an inn located in the [[Kandor]]i city of [[Canluum]]. It is generally considered the best inn in the city and consists of four stories. It is located at the foot of Stag's Stand, the tallest hill in the city, in an upmarket area with many shops and eateries catering to the nobility and rich merchant classes. In {{ne|979}}, it's proprietor was Master [[Helvin]] and among the staff was a stableman named [[Kazin]].

[[Moiraine Damodred]] was one of six [[Aes Sedai]] staying at the inn in early {{ne|979}}. She met [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] here and narrowly evaded being detained and questioned by her.{{ref/book|0|17}}
